# watchpapa

> watchpapa is a free media discovery platform for browsing films, TV shows, and people. Powered by TMDB metadata. Not a streaming service — a discovery and tracking tool.

## Content

- [Home](https://watchpapa.tv/) — Popular and trending films, TV shows, and people
- [Movies](https://watchpapa.tv/movies) — Film catalogue with cast, crew, and metadata
- [Shows](https://watchpapa.tv/shows) — TV series catalogue with seasons and episodes
- [People](https://watchpapa.tv/people) — Actors, directors, writers, and crew members
- [Releases Calendar](https://watchpapa.tv/calendar) — Upcoming movie and TV release dates
- [Updates](https://watchpapa.tv/updates) — Platform news and feature announcements
- [About](https://watchpapa.tv/about) — About watchpapa
- [Help](https://watchpapa.tv/help) — FAQ and usage guide
- [Subscription Plans](https://watchpapa.tv/subscription) — Tier information
- [Privacy Policy](https://watchpapa.tv/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://watchpapa.tv/terms)
- [Contact](https://watchpapa.tv/contact)

## Data Attribution

Content metadata is sourced from TMDB (The Movie Database) under their API terms of use. Streaming availability data is sourced from third-party APIs.
